# infisical_group_assignment (Data Source)

Read how a group is linked into the organization the provider is scoped to, typically a root-organization group linked into a sub-organization, along with the roles it holds there. Scope the provider to the sub-organization through `auth.organization_slug`. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

# Scope the provider to the sub-organization the group is linked into.
provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    organization_slug = "<sub-organization-slug>"
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

# Look up by slug (or use group_id instead).
data "infisical_group_assignment" "platform" {
  group_slug = "platform-engineering"
}

output "group_id" {
  value = data.infisical_group_assignment.platform.group_id
}

output "roles" {
  value = [for role in data.infisical_group_assignment.platform.roles : role.role_slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the linked group. Exactly one of `group_id` or `group_slug` must be set.
- `group_slug` (String) The slug of the linked group. Exactly one of `group_id` or `group_slug` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the group was linked.
- `group_name` (String) The name of the linked group.
- `group_org_id` (String) The ID of the organization that owns the group (the root organization).
- `id` (String) The ID of the group's membership in the organization.
- `roles` (Attributes List) The organization roles the group holds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `updated_at` (String) When the membership was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `custom_role_id` (String) The ID of the custom role, if the role is a custom one.
- `is_temporary` (Boolean) Whether the role is temporary.
- `role_slug` (String) The slug of the role. For custom roles, the custom role's slug.
- `temporary_access_end_time` (String) When temporary access ends.
- `temporary_access_start_time` (String) When temporary access begins.
- `temporary_mode` (String) The temporary access mode, if the role is temporary.
- `temporary_range` (String) The TTL of the temporary role, e.g. 1h.
